liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help on the Way** (1 review, 1 other source): Help>Slip>Frank opener appears on the Without a Net release, like the previous night's Eyes; Help>Slip>Frank from this show appears on Without A Net [1][19]
- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): Pre-space second-set stretch from Iko Iko through Terrapin runs about 42 minutes and flows together beautifully; Iko Iko, Playing, China Doll, Uncle John's Band and Terrapin run is called brilliant, with Jerry sounding sweet [21][27]
- **China Doll** (2 reviews): The transition from China Doll into Uncle John's Band gives the reviewer chills; China Doll into Uncle John's Band is singled out as very nice [21][26]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Seamless transitions from Playin' through Terrapin make the second set remarkable; reviewer first heard it on FM broadcast [19]
- **Standing on the Moon** (1 review): Standing on the Moon is nicely done, sung by Jerry [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-30.149442.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min [1]. Said about its sound: Right channel inversion was corrected, and levels were improved with gentle EQ and normalization [1]
- **gd1990-03-30.141956.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min [2]
- **gd1990-03-30.164132.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min [7]
- **gd90-03-30.sbd.gorinsky.8511.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 4.75/5 by 20 [11]
- **gd1990-03-30.sbd.cutler-mix.miller.89173.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audio boomy in the Cutler mix soundboard, though Jerry's voice comes through excellently [26]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended all three shows of the run and found this one played almost perfectly, with few flubs [28]
- Reviewer says the second set looks ordinary on paper compared with the previous night but the playing is outstanding [19]
- Reviewer prefers this show to the much-hyped previous night and ranks it among the top five of 1990 [20]
- Reviewer thinks Branford's guest spot the night before inspired the band for this show and the Atlanta run [28]
- Show was officially released in the Spring 1990 (The Other One) box set [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-30.149442.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.reMaster.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital Audience Recording by Ted Mattes; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & reMastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel March 30, 2020; source: From the Teddy Ballgame Archive - a reMaster of shnid 141956 Source: Schoeps CMC4 MK4 (ORTF) > Oade Modified Grace Preamp > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250)… [1]
- **gd1990-03-30.141956.FOB.Schoeps.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Ted Mattes Recording: Schoeps CMC4 MK4 (ORTF) > Oade Modified Grace Preamp > DAT 48k (Panasonic SV-250); Location: Sec b1 Row 20 Seat 8/9; Charlie Miller [2]. Also: DAT master from Ted Mattes, Schoeps mics, front-of-board; Charlie coordinated; this show was the last taping outing for Rick and Ted [2]
- **gd1990-03-30.164132.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 10, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [7]
- **gd90-03-30.sbd.gorinsky.8511.sbeok.shnf**: source: 24 track SBD MR>Healy 2 track Mixdown>C>DAT>CDR [11]. Also: Reviewer's early tape copy was unlabeled with most of Space edited out; Deadbase research identified the date [21]
- **gd1990-03-30.sbd.cutler-mix.miller.89173.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [12]

claims.text: Help>Slip>Frank opener appears on the Without a Net release, like the previous night's Eyes
Seamless transitions from Playin' through Terrapin make the second set remarkable; reviewer first heard it on FM broadcast
Reviewer says the second set looks ordinary on paper compared with the previous night but the playing is outstanding
Reviewer prefers this show to the much-hyped previous night and ranks it among the top five of 1990
The transition from China Doll into Uncle John's Band gives the reviewer chills
Pre-space second-set stretch from Iko Iko through Terrapin runs about 42 minutes and flows together beautifully
Reviewer's early tape copy was unlabeled with most of Space edited out; Deadbase research identified the date
Reviewer finds the audio boomy in the Cutler mix soundboard, though Jerry's voice comes through excellently
Standing on the Moon is nicely done, sung by Jerry
China Doll into Uncle John's Band is singled out as very nice
Iko Iko, Playing, China Doll, Uncle John's Band and Terrapin run is called brilliant, with Jerry sounding sweet
Reviewer attended all three shows of the run and found this one played almost perfectly, with few flubs
Reviewer thinks Branford's guest spot the night before inspired the band for this show and the Atlanta run
DAT master from Ted Mattes, transferred with Schoeps microphones; this version is a remaster
Right channel inversion was corrected, and levels were improved with gentle EQ and normalization
Help>Slip>Frank from this show appears on Without A Net
DAT master from Ted Mattes, Schoeps mics, front-of-board; Charlie coordinated; this show was the last taping outing for Rick and Ted
Show was officially released in the Spring 1990 (The Other One) box set
Soundboard recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, with a patch source recorded by Ted Mattes
